leadText:
Volume 57 is the 57th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga. It is the third volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's English translation, this volume is published as volume two of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: X•Y".
plainText:
Volume 57 is the 57th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga. It is the third volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's English translation, this volume is published as volume two of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: X•Y".

==Blurb==
The mystery of Mega Evolution begins to unravel, and new Pokémon join X and Y and their friends as they face an intensifying battle! Meanwhile, the headquarters of the Mega Evolution family, the Tower of Mastery, is under attack by a mysterious figure in a mechanical suit! Who is the masked marauder named Essentia?!
